cohort: A 40-year-old woman with no history of hemophilia or hemostasis disorders, who presented with sudden profuse vaginal bleeding and multiple subcutaneous hematomas at the site of the cesarean scar ten days postoperation.
finding: This case highlights the importance of considering UAP in the differential diagnosis of postpartum hemorrhage and demonstrates the efficacy of surgical intervention when radiological embolization is not available.
mod_finding: The uterine artery pseudoaneurysm developed following an emergency cesarean section.
